days.title: 昼の旧市街
days.morning: Buy a ticket and visit the Covered Bridge, Fujian Assembly Hall and Tan Ky house.
days.afternoon: Cycle to Bay Mau coconut forest for a basket boat ride.
days.evening: Release lanterns on the Hoai river, eat cao lầu and browse the night market.

days.title: 工芸村とビーチ
days.morning: Cooking class and Tra Que vegetable village.
days.afternoon: Swim at An Bang beach and get an áo dài tailored.
days.evening: Bánh mì Phượng and the "Hoi An Memories" show.

days.title: ミーソン聖域
days.morning: The My Son Cham temple complex – a UNESCO site.
days.afternoon: Thanh Ha pottery village and Kim Bong carpentry village.
days.evening: Mì Quảng and bánh xèo near Ba Le well.

days.title: チャム島
days.morning: Speedboat to Cu Lao Cham for snorkelling.
days.afternoon: Swim at Chong beach and visit Hai Tang pagoda.
days.evening: Back in Hoi An, coffee overlooking the Thu Bon river.

days.title: バーナーヒルズ
days.morning: Ba Na cable car and the Golden Bridge.
days.afternoon: French Village and Le Jardin flower garden.
days.evening: See the Dragon Bridge at night in Da Nang.
